correctness.rationale: For aligned harmonic Zipf rates and weights, the rescaled discovered mass Y_n(a) is a sum of independent Bernoulli variables with mean S_n(a)=sum_j(1−exp(−a/j))/j. Its deterministic exact root a_n is unique. Euler–Maclaurin expansion of the infinite mean and finite tail gives a_n=B_n+B_n²/n(1+o(1)), B_n=exp(theta H_n−2gamma). The variance satisfies aV_n(a)→1/2 and a triangular-array Lyapunov estimate yields the exact-root-centered hitting-time N(0,1/2) law. Bias (a_n−B_n)/sqrt(B_n)∼B_n^(3/2)/n creates theta=2/3 shift e^(−2gamma). Independently solved finite roots at several n and theta and checked the predicted bias ratios approach one. Finite checks do not prove the CLT.
